name: @wp2emdash/backups
description: Backups & Restore for EmDash on Cloudflare Workers: nightly content backups to the site's own R2 bucket (30 daily + 12 monthly), a Backups admin page (admins only) with one-time downloads, settings / menus / single-page restore with a preview diff, alerts, a monthly restore test into a scratch database and an optional off-site copy
